title: Message should not hidden when resize width of channel

issues.title: Message should not hidden when resize width of channel
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
when resize width of channel, message is hidden and need to scroll down to bottom of channel to see it.

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Drag channel to resize width of channel 
3. Send a message
4. Notice the new message is hidden under of the input message field. User need to scroll channel to see it

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/0b056fcc-24a8-4e01-8645-1db5ecd26b56)

## ⚙️ Expected behavior

The message should always be upper than input message 

## 🖥️ Screencast


https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/f44220ea-99fc-4aff-8220-a8e4b97d1a73


## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
